count_definitions.schema_complete: Every row contains the required atomic claim, reproduction, result, authority, evidence, parity, status, and future-verification fields.
count_definitions.ready_input: The observed reference input has no recorded discovery blocker; clone/test statuses remain unknown/not_run.
count_definitions.blocked: The row is indexed but one or more named gaps prevent a coding-ready parity claim.
count_definitions.excluded: The row preserves an approved scope or branding boundary and is not implementation scope.

privacy_and_clean_room.evidence_basis: Only previously privacy-reviewed runtime evidence, structured discovery records, and purpose-created fixtures were indexed.

next_ticket_effect: The final recursive audit disposition is READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION; rerun audit-dossier.mjs after any canonical discovery change.
